g.text: Codex Development Workflow - Main-Agent-Led Staged Process
main agent receives findings • changes • tests • risks
TDD is a conditional test strategy inside a Slice.
Use the smallest verification set that gives enough evidence.
Stop after the selected level passes unless escalation is justified.
work uses the Ticket path too.
Tiny work may use one implicit Slice
without an Issue or Ticket branch.
Keep dependent, overlapping, or shared-interface work sequential.
Open the PR before this single review gate.
Use the final PR diff, branch boundary, and CI results.
Fix findings and re-test before merge; do not add a second routine review.
Repo_Current_State.md is the compact recovery point
for current focus, verified behavior, failures, and next Slice.
Ticket detail and progress, when present,
tests, and unresolved risks—not raw logs.
